1. Sign in to your Apple Account and open Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords.
2. Generate an app-specific password and complete verification. Two-factor authentication must be enabled.
3. Enter your full iCloud email address and the generated password, not your Apple Account password.
1. 登录 Google 账户，进入「安全性与登录」→「您的 Google 账号:
1. Sign in to your Google Account. Open Security & sign-in → How you sign in to Google → 2-Step Verification and complete setup.
2. Open App passwords below, name the app (e.g. islo), and copy the generated 16-character password.
3. Enter your full Gmail address and app password, not your Google password. If this option is missing, check organization restrictions, Advanced Protection or security-key-only verification.
